text:
Alex Kim: Hey team — I'm Alex, starting today on Eng. Quick access issue: I can't sign into Google Drive. Okta shows 'Pending: MFA enrollment required' but when I try to enroll it loops on 'device trust' and the push never arrives. Also 1Password says no seats available. Who should I ping?
People Ops: Welcome Alex! :wave: Tagging IT — @it-support — and infra — @jonas — to help with provisioning.
IT Support: Hi Alex, welcome! Can you paste the exact Okta message or a screenshot? Also what's your work email (alias)?
Alex Kim: Thanks — it's alex.kim@redwood.com. Okta modal says: "Device trust required" and when I try to enroll it errors. Console shows:
```
Failed to register passkey: NotAllowedError
Request ID: abc123def
```
People Ops: FYI, we sometimes do a temporary device-trust lift for personal laptops until a company device ships. @it-support can you check?
Jonas (infra): If it's a personal Mac you'll need to register a passkey or install Okta Verify. People Ops — do we have a short-lived exception we can apply?
IT Support: Ok — creating temp ticket. Alex, are you on a company laptop or personal? Which browser?
Alex Kim: Personal MBP, macOS 13.6.1, Chrome stable. No YubiKey yet.
IT Support: Got it. I'm adding you to a "temp-device-trust" group for 24h and re-sending the Okta invite. Try enrolling in an Incognito window after I confirm.
onboard-bot: Account provisioning update — Google Workspace: invite_sent, Okta: group=engineers status=pending, 1Password: seat_status=pending.
Lina (eng): Hey Alex, welcome! If you need quick repo access ping me. Also for SSH to the temp devbox drop your pubkey here or DM: `ssh-rsa AAAAB3NzaC1yc2EAAAADAQABAAABAQD... alex@macbook`
IT Support: Temp group added, re-sent Okta enrollment email. Try incognito now and let me know the error if it persists.
Alex Kim: Incognito worked — I could complete Okta enrollment and open Drive. Thank you! Still seeing 1Password seat pending though.
IT Support: Working on 1Password seat. You should get an invite to your email in ~5-10 mins. If not, I'll DM a temporary emergency vault link.
Alex Kim: Invite just arrived and I can sign in. All good now. Thanks everyone :tada:
People Ops: Great — welcome aboard again! If anything else pops up, drop a note here or in #eng-it-requests. Also here's the onboarding checklist: https://redwood.com/onboarding/checklist
